description: This file implements polyfills and management for custom elements, mutation observers, and web component features, including registration, upgrade, and DOM mutation handling for web components.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill for WeakMap if not natively supported, used for tracking DOM node registrations and observers.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: A polyfill for MutationObserver, used for observing DOM mutations in environments lacking native support.

classes.name: MutationRecord
classes.description: Represents information about a DOM mutation, used within the mutation observer polyfill.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: Handles registration of mutation observers for DOM nodes, managing event listeners and callback enqueuing.

methods.name: scheduleCallback
methods.description: Schedules mutation observer callbacks to be executed.

methods.name: wrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Wraps DOM nodes with Shadow DOM polyfill if necessary.

methods.name: dispatchCallbacks
methods.description: Dispatches queued mutation records to observers.

methods.name: removeTransientObserversFor
methods.description: Removes transient observers for a given observer.

methods.name: forEachAncestorAndObserverEnqueueRecord
methods.description: Enqueues mutation records for ancestors of a target node.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades a DOM node to a custom element if applicable.

methods.name: upgradeWithDefinition
methods.description: Upgrades a DOM element with a specific custom element definition.

methods.name: implementPrototype
methods.description: Sets the prototype of a custom element, either via __proto__ or mixin.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Calls the createdCallback of a custom element if defined.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new custom element with the document.

methods.name: overrideAttributeApi
methods.description: Overrides setAttribute and removeAttribute to trigger attributeChangedCallback.

methods.name: changeAttribute
methods.description: Helper to change attributes and trigger callbacks.

methods.name: resolveTagName
methods.description: Resolves the tag name for a custom element definition.

methods.name: resolvePrototypeChain
methods.description: Sets up the prototype chain for custom elements, especially in non-__proto__ environments.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Creates an element instance from a custom element definition.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML element, considering custom element definitions.

methods.name: createElementNS
methods.description: Creates an element in a namespace, considering custom element definitions.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the web components polyfill after DOM is ready.
